title: Proper Names from the Small Plates:Some Notes on the Personal Names Zoram, Jarom, Omni, and Mosiah
author: Stephen D. Ricks
abstract: Abstract: With a selection of a few notable examples (Zoram, Jarom, Omni, and Mosiah) that have been analyzed by the ongoing Book of Mormon names project, Stephen Ricks argues that “proper names in the Book of Mormon are demonstrably ancient.”
